Isha (Engineer): Hey team, my May paystub shows both Indian PF contribution AND a US 401(k) deferral. Im on India local contract effective 2026-05-01. Net is much lower. Link: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/Isha/2026-05>

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks Isha. Can payroll confirm payrun and GID?

Meera (Payroll Ops): Payrun PR-20260531-11, GID RWF-9801. System exported `PF_IN` and `401K_US_PRE`. Looks like benefits vendor kept US deferral active while country switched at cutoff.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-14590 created: "Isha - PF + 401k double deduction" (assigned Meera).

Anika (Global Mobility): Mobility shows India contract effective 2026-05-01 and PF registration uploaded 2026-05-02. I'll attach docs to PAY-14590.

Tom (Tax): We'll want payroll to reverse the 401(k) deferral and coordinate vendor refund. Also confirm employer PF remit. If reversal after US year-end, W-2c might be needed.

Jin (Payroll): Plan: reverse `401K_US_PRE` on PR-20260531-11, post net correction next cycle, contact retirement vendor for refund. ETA: reversals by 06/10. Will post journals to payroll-recon.

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks all  Isha, we'll DM timeline once done.
